plan.summary: BRO-5451: the Harry Potter and the Cursed Child national tour (harry-potter-tour-2024) was closed on 2026-10-11, the last stop on the Tours To You page when the entry was auto-created. The page now lists the same tour resuming 2027-03-31 (Buffalo, Shea's PAC) through 2027-09-12 (Cleveland), with no relaunch, so the closing was a hiatus. The hand-verified closing blocks the automatic reopen and keeps the health row 'closed national tour lists new dates' firing. Clear closingDate and reopen it.
